# Brightwater Analytics announces Project Atlas

Published 2026-10-28.

Brightwater Analytics today announced Project Atlas, a self-service
reporting tool for small logistics teams. Brightwater Analytics is a
forty-person analytics firm based in a mid-sized harbour town and has built
custom dashboards for regional carriers since 2019.

Project Atlas lets a dispatcher build a delivery-performance report without
writing queries. The first public release is planned for early 2027, after a
closed pilot with three customers.

"Our customers kept asking for the same five reports," said Mara Quint,
head of product at Brightwater Analytics. "Project Atlas puts those reports
in their hands, so our analysts can work on the hard questions."

Project Atlas will be priced per team rather than per seat.
